含蓄条件句:without / but for / otherwise: 不用 if 也能暗示条件:介词短语 without/but for 与副词 otherwise 暗含虚拟条件,时态按虚拟规则选。
Without/But for + 名词 = If it were not for / had not been for|与现在事实相反:would/should + 动词原形|与过去事实相反:would have + 过去分词|otherwise = if not(否则),暗含前句条件|but that + 从句也表"若不是"|判断技巧:看暗含条件指向现在还是过去
Without your help, I would have failed.
column3: 没有你的帮助,我就失败了。

含蓄条件句:without / but for / otherwise: But for the rain, we would have arrived on time.
column3: 要不是下雨,我们就准时到了。

含蓄条件句:without / but for / otherwise: I was busy that day; otherwise I would have come.
column3: 那天我很忙,否则我就来了。

# title: ___ your advice, we would have taken the wrong road.
column4: 要不是你的建议,用 Without 表含蓄条件。

# title: But for the storm, the ship ___ on time.
column4: 对过去的含蓄虚拟:would have arrived。

# title: I didn't know your number; otherwise I ___ you.
Without air, there ___ no living things on earth.
column4: 与现在事实相反的含蓄虚拟:would be。

# title: ___ the heavy traffic, we would have caught the train.
column4: 要不是堵车,用 But for。

# title: He was not free yesterday; otherwise he ___ to the meeting.
column4: otherwise 指过去,用 would have come。
